spec.title: ISS foil drink bag squeezed into tubing and foam block
spec.summary: A person aboard a station holds and squeezes a silver foil drink bag so red fruit punch flows through clear tubing into a white foam block, then removes the bag from the blue work surface.

variants.title: Taller block
variants.summary: The foam block is taller, so the tubing must land deeper in its pocket.
